chat_history.content: List the names of the main actors in the TV show 'Friends' along with their birthdays.

content.content: We need to provide names of main actors of Friends and their birthdays. Respond with list. Use knowledge cutoff. Main cast: Jennifer Aniston, Courteney Cox, Lisa Kudrow, Matt LeBlanc, Matthew Perry, David Schwimmer. Provide birthdays: Jennifer Aniston: February 11, 1969; Courteney Cox: June 5, 1964; Lisa Kudrow: July 30, 1963; Matt LeBlanc: July 25, 1967; Matthew Perry: August 19, 1969; David Schwimmer: August 2, 1966. Also maybe mention the birthdate of the actors. Provide nicely formatted list. No need to use function. Ok.

content:
**Main cast of “Friends” and their birthdays**

| Actor | Character | Birthday |
|-------|-----------|----------|
| Jennifer Aniston | Rachel Green | **February 11, 1969** |
| Courteney Cox | Monica Geller | **June 5, 1964** |
| Lisa Kudrow | Phoebe Buffay | **July 30, 1963** |
| Matt LeBlanc | Joey Tribbiani | **July 25, 1967** |
| Matthew Perry | Chandler Bing | **August 19, 1969** |
| David Schwimmer | Ross Geller | **August 2, 1966** |

These six actors form the core ensemble that made “Friends” a cultural phenomenon.
